name: Accept Invitation Membership
summary: Adds one external workspace membership to the explicitly selected durable identity and consumes the invitation without changing home or current workspace.

preconditions.expression: invitation-status == acceptance-pending and durable-identity == resolved and home-workspace == established

setup: Explicitly confirm the selected durable identity and invitation acceptance.

postconditions.expression: invitation-status == accepted and workspace-membership == multiple and home-workspace unchanged and current-workspace unchanged
